name: Glama MCP Directory
description: Third-party MCP server directory with quality grading and an online inspector.
descriptionZh: 第三方 MCP 服务器目录，提供质量分级与在线 inspector。
license: Proprietary (directory); synced source list is MIT
keyFact: Glama runs a third-party directory of MCP servers that mirrors the community-maintained punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers list and adds A–F quality grading plus an online inspector; it is independent of the official registry at registry.modelcontextprotocol.io.
keyFactZh: Glama 运营一个第三方 MCP 服务器目录，同步社区维护的 punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers 清单，并额外提供 A–F 质量分级与在线 inspector；它与官方 registry.modelcontextprotocol.io 相互独立。
caveat: A discovery directory rather than a runtime tool; its grading methodology is not published in detail, so treat rankings as indicative rather than authoritative.
caveatZh: 它是发现型目录而非运行时工具；其分级方法未详细公开，因此评级仅供参考，不宜当作权威结论。
